units.source_text: 僧都答道：“公子此言，实在令人感激！

en.t: The bishop replied, “My lord, your words are truly moving!

units.source_text: 可是这孩子年纪太小，全不懂事，恐怕做公子的游戏伴侣也还不配呢。

en.t: But this child is far too young and understands nothing at all; I fear she is not yet fit even to be your playmate.

units.source_text: 但凡女子，总须受人爱抚，方能成人。

en.t: As for girls, they must always be loved and cherished by others before they can grow into full adults.

units.source_text: 惟贫僧乃方外之人，此种事情不能详谈，且待与其外祖母商议之后，再行禀复。”

en.t: But I am a monk removed from worldly affairs, and cannot discuss such matters in detail; after I have consulted with her grandmother, I shall report back to you.”

units.source_text: 这僧都语言冷淡，态度古板，年轻的源氏公子听了这话觉得难以为情，便不再谈下去。

en.t: The bishop spoke coldly and behaved stiffly, so the young Lord Genji felt embarrassed when he heard this and did not pursue the subject further.

units.source_text: 僧都说道：“此间近正安设佛堂，须做功德。

en.t: The bishop said, “We are presently preparing a Buddhist hall here and must perform the proper devotions.

units.source_text: 今天初夜诵经尚未结束。

en.t: Tonight’s first evening sutra recitation has not yet ended.

units.source_text: 结束之后，当即前来奉陪。”

en.t: Once it is finished, I will come at once to attend upon you.”
Having said this, he went up to the Buddhist hall.
